meta.title: Soil and Soul Istria — All-inclusive Culinary Group Journeys
meta.description: 5-day culinary journey through Istria. Truffle hunting, wine tastings, world's best olive oil, Michelin-starred dinner. Groups of 10–34. From €1,090/person.

hero.title: Soil and Soul Istria
hero.subtitle: A Culinary Journey Through the Soul of Istria

why.label: Why This Trip?
why.title: 5 Reasons Why Istria Should Be Your Next Gourmet Destination

points.title: Truffle — Freshly Shaved Over Your Pasta
points.text: Join the Karlić family and their trained dogs in the hunt for world-renowned Istrian truffles — top specimens reach up to €4,000/kg. Afterward, cook and enjoy a 3-course meal together.

points.title: Olive Oil from the World's Best Region — 9 Years Running
points.text: Istria has been named the world's best olive oil region 9 consecutive times by Flos Olei. Taste the oils of Chiavalon, the Flos Olei "Producer of the Year."

points.title: Wines from "4 Soils" — One Malvazija, Four Characters
points.text: The "4 Soils" concept (red, white, grey, black earth) produces four distinct Malvazija characters. At Kozlović, winemakers since 1904, you'll taste the difference.

points.title: Farewell Dinner at Croatia's First Michelin Restaurant
points.text: Your final evening: dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Rovinj — overlooking the Adriatic with a menu that gives Istrian traditions a modern twist.

points.title: An Abandoned Stone Village as Your Private Base
points.text: Kotli — a fully restored medieval village in the Mirna valley. 8 stone houses, pool, panoramic terrace. No neighbors. Just your group.

why.photoAlt: Degustacijski stol u masliniku pri zalazu sunca

hosts.label: Your Hosts
hosts.title: The People Behind the Experience
hosts.subtitle: No anonymous guides — you'll meet the families who have shaped Istria's gastronomy for generations.

cards.name: The Karlić Family
cards.bio: Istria's most renowned truffle-hunting family takes you through their museum, forest, and kitchen.
cards.quote: The truffle chooses when to reveal itself. We just follow the dogs.

cards.name: The Kozlović Family
cards.bio: Pioneers of the Istrian wine renaissance. Their Malvazija from red soil is a classic.
cards.quote: Each of our four soils tells a different story in the glass.

cards.name: Sandi Chiavalon
cards.role: Flos Olei · Producer of the Year
cards.bio: One of the world's finest olive oil producers. His oils have been winning top international awards for years.
cards.quote: Istrian oil is liquid gold — purer than any Tuscan.

cards.name: Family Konobas
cards.bio: In the konobas, families cook from recipes that have been passed down for centuries.
cards.quote: Grandmother still cooks with us — and you can taste it.

agenda.title: 5 Days of Local Cuisine — Istria · Your Itinerary
agenda.subtitle: Every day is carefully planned. All you have to do is enjoy.

days.title: Welcome to Kotli
days.narrative: You arrive at an abandoned stone village that has come back to life. On the terrace, Biska awaits — the traditional Istrian mistletoe brandy — along with Pršut, cheese, and a glass of Teran.

schedule.text: Welcome aperitif on the panoramic terrace
Dinner at the konoba — Fuži with truffles, Teran wine

days.title: The Gold of Istria
days.narrative: A full day with the Karlić family — from the truffle museum to the hunt in the forest to cooking together. You'll shave truffle over handmade pasta.

schedule.text: Breakfast basket delivered to your door
Karlić Tartufi: Museum → Truffle hunt → Cooking class → 3-course meal

days.host: The Karlić Family — Truffle hunters for 3 generations

days.title: The Flavors of Istria
days.narrative: Taste olive oils that have captivated the world and discover the "4 Soils" of Istrian Malvazija at two wineries. To finish: the smallest town in the world.

schedule.text: Kozlović Winery — Malvazija from red soil, since 1904
Roxanich (Motovun) — tasting + lunch with wine pairing
Walking tour of Hum — the smallest town in the world (23 residents)
Dinner at Konoba Hum + Biska tasting

days.title: From Hilltop Villages to the Sea
days.narrative: Grožnjan — the artists' village. Motovun — the fortress above the truffle forests. And then: Rovinj. Your farewell dinner at Croatia's first Michelin-starred restaurant.

schedule.text: Rovinj — old town tour, harbor, free time
Gift package — wine, truffle, olive oil from Istria

destinations.label: Places You'll Visit
destinations.title: Rovinj · Motovun · Hum
destinations.subtitle: Three Istrian jewels — from the most romantic harbor on the Adriatic to the truffle fortress to the smallest town in the world.

cards.name: Rovinj
cards.desc: Istria's most romantic coastal town. Pastel-colored houses jut out into the sea. Here you'll enjoy your farewell dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant — at sunset over the Adriatic.

cards.name: Motovun
cards.desc: A medieval hilltop fortress surrounded by Europe's most famous truffle forests. In the morning mist of the Mirna hides Istria's gold.

cards.name: Hum
cards.desc: The smallest town in the world — 23 residents, one alley, one konoba. Here you'll taste Biska, Istria's mystical mistletoe brandy.

accommodation.label: Your Accommodation
accommodation.title: Stone Houses in Kotli
accommodation.subtitle: An abandoned stone village, revived as a unique retreat in the heart of Istria.
accommodation.intro: Kotli is a tiny stone village in the heart of Istria, where the Mirna river cascades into the basin-shaped hollows that gave the place its name. Once the main mill village of the Hum region, today the old mill still stands against time and the stone houses carry the warmth of Istrian life.

features.title: 8 Authentic Stone Houses
features.text: 80–140 m² houses with living room, kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom. For 2–5 guests. Fireplace, Wi-Fi, TV, private parking.

features.title: Pool, BBQ Area & Panoramic Terrace
features.text: Shared outdoor pool, large BBQ area, and terrace overlooking the green Mirna valley.

features.title: Pet-Friendly
features.text: Dogs and cats welcome (€10/day). Perfect walking trails right at your doorstep.

features.title: Getting There
features.text: Pula Airport 1h · Trieste 1.5h · Ljubljana 2h · Munich 5h · Vienna 7h · Zurich 8h. Shuttle on request.

items.a: Soil and Soul Istria is a group experience for 10–34 guests. You can travel as a group leader with your own group (from 10 guests, you travel free!) — ideal for wine clubs, gourmet travel groups, or team building. On request, we can also match you with an existing group.

items.q: How do I get to Kotli?
items.a: Most guests drive: Munich 5h, Vienna 7h, Zurich 8h. Alternatively: fly to Pula (1h transfer), Trieste (1.5h), or Ljubljana (2h). On request, we can arrange an airport shuttle service.

All main activities work in the rain: truffle cooking class, wine tastings, olive oil tasting, and konoba visits are indoors. Only the truffle hunt in the forest is rescheduled in heavy rain or replaced with an extended cooking session.

Yes! Istrian cuisine is rich in vegetarian dishes: truffle pasta, vegetable Maneštra, grilled vegetables, local cheese. Vegan and gluten-free options are arranged on request at all restaurants. Please let us know your dietary requirements when booking.

Free cancellation up to 60 days before arrival (full refund of deposit). 30–59 days: 50% refund. Under 30 days: no refund. We recommend travel cancellation insurance. Deposit: 30% at booking, balance due 30 days before arrival.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: SEPA bank transfer and credit card (Visa, Mastercard). All prices include VAT. No hidden fees.
Yes! The stone houses are pet-friendly (€10/day). Private gardens, perfect walking trails. Please mention this when booking so we can assign the right house.

items.q: Can any trip be booked privately?
items.a: Yes — any scheduled trip can be booked as a private group trip. Your date, your group, your customizations. Contact us for a personalized offer.
